title: Perfect Pork Loin and Potatoes
reject_reason: Apricot-glazed boneless pork loin roast with red potatoes and onion is the same pork-loin-roast-with-potatoes dinner as live dutch-oven-pork-loin-roast-gravy (word-overlap 33, shares pork-loin/onions/oil); the glaze does not distinguish the plate, consistent with the pork-roast-recipe dupe ruling.
